_description: User Acceptance Test plan for Project Clarity Phase 1. Structured by persona and feature so each stakeholder runs only their scenarios. Each scenario maps back to a CLARITY epic/pain point for traceability.

testData.note: Mock auth accepts any password. For live-mode UAT with real OAuth, stakeholders use their DynPro SSO credentials.

scenarios.title: Create Lean T&M SOW — golden path
scenarios.expected: SOW created in 'pending_approval', routed to standard approval chain (margin ≥ 35%). Audit trail records creation.

scenarios.title: Low-margin SOW escalates to SLT
steps: Create SOW with configured rates producing margin 18%
scenarios.expected: Approval routing resolves to SLT chain (Shiv). Warning banner visible in wizard Review step.

scenarios.title: Approver rejects SOW with comments
steps: Open a pending SOW, click Reject, enter comment 'Rate card not aligned'
scenarios.expected: SOW status → 'rejected'. Finance Head sees rejection reason on next refresh.

scenarios.title: Legal clauses auto-injected and flagged
steps: Create an Elaborate T&M SOW against an MSA with non-standard IP clauses
scenarios.expected: Auto-inject clauses listed. Any blocked/manual-review clauses surfaced with yellow/red badges.

scenarios.title: Resource view shows weekly utilization
scenarios.expected: Resources listed with color-coded utilization (red >100%, yellow 80–100%, green <80%). Week headers scrollable.

scenarios.title: Click resource to see allocations by project
steps: From Resource View, click a resource row
scenarios.expected: Drill-down shows all project allocations with % and start/end dates.

scenarios.title: Over-allocation alert triggers
steps: Assign a resource currently at 90% to a new project at 30%
scenarios.expected: Validation error: 'Assignment would exceed 100% for week W'. Record not created.

scenarios.title: Project burnt report renders variance vs baseline
scenarios.expected: Stat cards show planned vs actual hours, revenue, margin. Variance chart renders per resource.

scenarios.title: Margin erosion >10% shows red status
steps: Open a project where actual margin is 7% below plan
scenarios.expected: Overall status badge = red. Margin variance cell highlighted.

scenarios.title: Export to Excel
steps: Click Export Excel on a loaded report
scenarios.expected: XLSX downloads with summary + per-resource breakdown sheets.

scenarios.title: Create additive change order
scenarios.expected: Financial impact preview shows net +$50,000. CO routed for approval. SOW value unchanged until approval.

scenarios.title: Approved CO updates parent SOW value
scenarios.expected: Parent SOW total value reflects new amount. Audit entry recorded.

scenarios.title: Assignment creation triggers JobDiva record + notification
steps: Create a new assignment with valid capacity and standard bill rate
scenarios.expected: Assignment appears in list. JobDiva mock log shows created record. Back-office email logged.

scenarios.title: Bill rate below standard flagged
steps: Try to create assignment with rate 20% below role standard
scenarios.expected: Warning surfaced; requires justification before submit.

scenarios.title: Integration health dashboard shows healthy stack
scenarios.expected: Overall=healthy. JobDiva, DocuSign, SharePoint cards green with latency <2s. All 5 queues show completed>0 after activity.

scenarios.title: SOW approval triggers DocuSign envelope
scenarios.expected: Envelope created. SharePoint document uploaded under /PMO/ProjectClarity/SOWs. SOW status reflects 'sent_for_signature'.

scenarios.title: DocuSign webhook marks envelope complete
steps: POST /api/docusign/simulate/<envelopeId> with action=sign for each signer
scenarios.expected: SOW status → 'signed'. Baseline plan locked. Signed document uploaded to /SOWs/Signed.

scenarios.title: SLT sees portfolio margin view
scenarios.expected: Portfolio-level KPIs visible (total SOW value, active projects, margin variance). FLC values are visible (has flc:read).

scenarios.title: Low-margin SOW appears in SLT approval queue
scenarios.expected: Only SOWs requiring SLT sign-off (margin < configured threshold) listed.

scenarios.title: Sales role cannot see FLC or margin
steps: Login as a Sales role user
scenarios.expected: FLC and margin columns hidden or masked. API returns 403 for /api/burnt-reports.

scenarios.title: Integrations page hidden from non-admin
scenarios.expected: No 'Integrations' nav item. Direct GET /api/integration-health returns 403.

scenarios.title: Row-level security — PM only sees own projects
scenarios.expected: Only projects where Sharad is PM are visible.

severityDefinitions.critical: Blocks a sign-off scenario or causes data loss
severityDefinitions.high: Golden path works but is confusing or requires workaround

flow: Stakeholder files bug via Jira with screenshot + UAT scenario ID
Daily triage at 09:30 ET — assigns severity and owner
Critical bugs blocking sign-off fixed within 24h; deployed to UAT after smoke test passes
Medium/low bugs tracked for post-launch sprint
